$comment: An example team pack for a made-up company, Brinewick. A pack holds everything Keelcrew needs to know about how one team builds software; the core stays generic. It shows the format and backs the tests; setup never offers it. Make your own with keelctl pack init <team> (setup does), then extend it. The skill names under repos and agents (pre-pr-checks, smoke-test, code-review) stand for a team's own skills; Keelcrew doesn't ship them.
name: brinewick
title: Brinewick engineering (example)

jira.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

brinewick-api.notes: Read the repo's CLAUDE.md before changing code. Never apply database migrations without the captain.

proposals.$comment: When colleagues scan the same repos, the suggest and CTO agents keep a finding only when its main file's top recent author is the captain, so each finding lands on one board.

denyBash.why: the ship-it label starts a deploy
destructive make targets are never allowed

qa.notes: QA runs against https://qa.brinewick.test with the test accounts.

analyst.notes: Prod and qa are read-only: SELECTs and query plans only, through the brinewick-db MCP servers.
